groups.instruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.
groups.noteTitle: Presentation on how jobs might change in the future

questions.text: What do the students find surprising about the way that complaints were dealt with at the call centre?

options.t: the way that customers responded to it
the employees' lack of enthusiasm for it
the kind of questions employees were obliged to ask

questions.text: What does Emma say about the report by Jerry Kaplan?

options.t: It shows how machines will respond to human needs.
It emphasises the variety of roles that machines will have.
It explains the limitations of machines.

questions.text: What is Nick's reaction to the article The Human Cloud?

options.t: He agrees that companies should focus on making savings.
He supports the concept of greater flexibility for employees.
He approves of businesses spending more on recruiting experts.

questions.text: What do the students agree about the use of technology to collect information about employees?

options.t: Cameras are an effective means of maintaining security.
Sometimes productivity is more important than individual privacy.
Employees may object to certain types of monitoring.
